comment: Exceptions for resolving mirror.set service IDs to upstream aws/api-models-aws directories. scripts/specs-sync.sh first asks `mirrorgen -index` for the service ID that each upstream model actually declares, which resolves the large majority automatically and can never drift from the receiver's own ID derivation. This file covers only what that cannot resolve: (a) our service ID differs from the model's endpointPrefix, and (b) endpointPrefix is not unique upstream, so several services report the same one. Every mirror.set entry must appear in the index or in one of the maps below; scripts/specs-sync.sh fails loudly otherwise, and TestEveryServiceResolves enforces it without network access.

alias_notes.aws.apigateway: endpointPrefix apigateway, shared with API Gateway v2
alias_notes.aws.apigatewayv2: endpointPrefix apigateway, shared with API Gateway v1
alias_notes.aws.es: endpointPrefix es, shared with Elasticsearch Service; this is the OpenSearch pack (CreateDomain)
alias_notes.aws.events: endpointPrefix events, shared with CloudWatch Events; EventBridge is the current API
alias_notes.aws.lambda: endpointPrefix lambda, shared with Lambda Core (a 5-operation internal model)
alias_notes.aws.rds: endpointPrefix rds, shared with DocumentDB and Neptune
alias_notes.aws.docdb: endpointPrefix rds, shared with RDS and Neptune
alias_notes.aws.elbv2: endpointPrefix elasticloadbalancing, shared with ELB v1
alias_notes.aws.neptune: endpointPrefix rds, shared with RDS and DocumentDB
alias_notes.aws.timestream: endpointPrefix ingest.timestream; the pack implements the write control plane (CreateDatabase/CreateTable)
